frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Security and Privacy Controls
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: NIST SP 800-53 is a U.S. Government work not subject to copyright in the United States. Pack stores control IDs, official control titles, and baseline membership from the pinned OSCAL catalog.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: All 1,014 active controls and enhancements (20 families) are catalogued with LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/PRIVACY baseline tags. Identifier mappings and safeguard mappings are proposed until reviewed; this is catalog coverage, not an authorization.

frameworks.name: NIST Risk Management Framework (SP 800-37 Rev 2)
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: NIST SP 800-37 is a U.S. Government work not subject to copyright in the United States. Pack stores the 47 RMF task identifiers and task statements.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: All 47 RMF tasks across the Prepare, Categorize, Select, Implement, Assess, Authorize, and Monitor steps are catalogued. RMF tasks are process evidence; mappings are proposed until reviewed.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 Cloud security controls
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: ISO standard text is licensed. Pack stores clause identifiers and short internal titles only; customers must hold their own license for the official PDF.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy information management
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: ISO standard text is licensed. No controls are stored for the withdrawn 2019 edition.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: No controls seeded: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 was withdrawn when the 2025 edition was published on 2025-10-14; 2019 certificates remain valid until October 2028. Coverage lives on iso-27701-2025.
evidence_focus: Privacy information management scope and roles
PII processing inventory, purpose, and data-flow evidence
Privacy risk, data-subject rights, and supplier evidence
frameworks.next_step: Use iso-27701-2025. Seed 2019 identifiers only if an open source verifies them and a 2019-certified tenant needs them before October 2028.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2025 Privacy information management
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: ISO standard text is licensed; the pack stores Annex A identifiers and short titles only and links the official source. Customers must hold their own license for the standard.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: 10 of the 78 Annex A controls are seeded: those whose identifier and short title agree across two independent non-vendor sources (BSI and Schellman). The other 68 are listed as gaps in frameworks/packs/data/iso_27701_2025.json until a second source verifies them. Clauses 4-10 are not seeded.
evidence_focus: Cross-border transfer basis and disclosure records
Subprocessor register, notices, and temporary-file disposal
frameworks.next_step: Verify the remaining 68 Annex A identifiers against a second standards or certification body source, or a licensed copy, then seed them.
